messages:
lee: quick sync — post-mortem from last night's paging: we should standardize internal comms templates. too many ad-hoc replies during handoff.

sam: +1. want 3 canonical variants: public status page, customer notice, internal Ops/leadership brief. keep them single source of truth.

incident-bot: [ALERT] Incident 2026-03-15T02:45Z - Elevated tail latency for embeddings service (us-east-1). Assigned to elle.

elle: oncall — will manage. setting up handoff in 15. please avoid sending external comms until we confirm scope.

ops-bot: HANDOFF ALERT: elle -> maya at 03:00 UTC. facts: start 02:45 UTC, impact: high tail latency; suspected noisy neighbor; mitigation: isolate instance group and failover traffic. monitor window 45m.

maya: i'm drafting templates now. does legal want a hard line to use about data exposure? @devon

devon: include {{compliance_statement}}. guidance: if not verified, say 'We are investigating potential data exposure; we will follow up.' If verified none, say 'No customer data was exposed.' Also include contact security@redwood.com.

lee: good. two further asks: 1) status page must be <200 words, headline first 2) internal should include TL;DR, timeline, next steps, owners. 3) customer-facing should have clear 'what this means for you' bullets.

sam: draft templates below. react :eyes: for style, :thumbsup: for content.

sam: ```PUBLIC STATUS PAGE (short)

Headline: Degraded latency for {{service_name}} in {{region}}
Impact: Some requests experienced elevated latency or timeouts between {{start_time}} and {{end_time}}.
Scope: A subset of requests routed to {{model_alias}} were affected.
What we're doing: Isolating affected instances and redirecting traffic to healthy capacity.
Current status: Mitigation in progress. Expected improvement within {{eta_minutes}} minutes.
Next update: By {{next_update_window}} or sooner.
```

sam: ```CUSTOMER NOTICE (concise)

Hi {{customer_contact_name}},
TL;DR: Some requests to {{service_name}} in {{region}} experienced higher latency between {{start_time}} and {{end_time}}.
What happened: We observed an infrastructure issue causing increased response times for a fraction of requests.
What we did: Traffic was shifted away from affected instances and service performance is improving.
What this means for you: You may have seen slower responses or transient failures. If you have logs or request IDs, please include them when contacting support.
Compliance: {{compliance_statement}}
If you need immediate assistance, contact support@redwood.com.
Thanks,
Redwood Inference Support
```

sam: ```INTERNAL OPS BRIEF

Incident: {{incident_id}}
Start: {{start_time}}
Detect: {{detect_time}} - alert {{alert_name}}
Impact metrics: p95/p99 latency increase to {{p99_value}}ms; error rate up to {{error_rate}}% in {{region}}
Initial hypothesis: resource contention on shard pool-x; noisy workload suspected
Mitigation timeline:
- {{detect_time}}: alert fired
- {{mitigation_start}}: isolated instance group and started failover
- {{mitigation_end}}: failover complete, load shifting in progress
Owners: mitigation lead: {{mitigation_lead}}; comms: {{comms_owner}}; infra follow-up: {{infra_owner}}
Follow-ups: capacity tuning, autoscaler threshold adjustments, runbook update to include earlier fallback to standby pools
Notes for leadership: short summary + estimated customer impact count (if available) 
```

maya: style nit: for internal add a line 'Escalation level' and a :eyes: marker for things requiring exec attention. also add placeholder {{estimated_affected_customers}}.

sam: added. also adding a quick checklist at top for comms owners:

sam: ```COMMS OWNERS CHECKLIST
- Incident lead: draft and approve status page
- Comms owner: prepare customer notice, route via support + legal
- Support: send targeted emails to affected customers
- Legal/security: confirm compliance statement before send
- PR/marketing: optional customer updates for major incidents
```

lee: can we add a short 'pre-approved phrasing' list for common scenarios so oncall can copy-paste? reduces lawyer back-and-forth.

devon: yes — examples allowed but require checkboxes: e.g., 'No customer data was exposed.' and 'We are investigating and will update within X hours.' include {{investigation_status}} placeholder.

anna: I'll put these into the templates repo and create a single-file canonical doc. will tag with version and last-reviewed meta. will open PR and link here.

ops-bot: REMINDER: Handoff in 5 minutes unless incident escalates.

incident-bot: Incident 2067901111 status: Mitigation in progress - monitoring.

lee: thanks all. after PR merges, schedule a 30-min runbook demo for oncall rotation to practice sending these messages. ack please.

elle: ack — will attend. posting the final timeline in 40m.

anna: ack — PR opened at https://github.com/redwood/inference-templates/pull/412 link will be updated after merge.

sam: closing thread soon. great work on the checklist — should reduce noisy paging comms. :white_check_mark:
